name: io.github.sepehr071/iran-gold-mcp
title: Iran Gold Prices
description: Unofficial read-only live 18k gold prices on Iranian sites: Milli.gold, Wallgold, Melligold, Daric.

environmentVariables.name: IRAN_GOLD_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the gold platform requests; system proxy settings are ignored. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
